purpose: Interview an expert; teach 暴力/殺人/恐怖/原告/代理/執行/公表/怒り

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、暴力犯罪は減っているんですか？
lines.style: prepared interviewer asking, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 統計上は減っていますが、殺人は依然深刻です。
lines.en: Statistically yes, but murder remains grave.
lines.style: expert giving a balanced answer, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 被害者の恐怖を、社会はどう支えますか？
lines.en: How does society support victims’ fear?
lines.style: interviewer probing compassion, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 原告を支援する制度が整いつつあります。
lines.en: Systems to support plaintiffs are taking shape.
lines.style: expert noting progress, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 代理人の役割も大きいですね。
lines.en: The role of counsel is big too.
lines.style: interviewer acknowledging, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、刑の執行の透明性も求められています。
lines.en: Yes, transparency in enforcement is demanded too.
lines.style: expert raising another issue, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 判決の公表は、抑止につながりますか？
lines.style: interviewer pursuing the point, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 人々の怒りを、再発防止に向けることが大切です。
lines.en: Channeling people’s anger toward prevention matters.
lines.style: expert offering a constructive close, voice clear and distinctly their own
